report:
**Design choice: standalone researcher caller, not the durable worker runner.** `isswf-job.mjs`/`pi-worker-task.mjs` validate exactly one Luna/high tuple, `workerTotal` 1/2, worker-only profile files, and digest-pin every runtime file per `runtimeSha`; adding a researcher role rewrites a #68-gated runner and needs a new committed runtime plus package activation. A separate text-only caller reusing the existing pinned-blob/binding/exclusive-admission/append-only patterns is smaller, leaves worker and #68 untouched, and has a concrete consumer: the coordinator's research dispatch. Not an unused policy module; offline injected-SDK tests exercise that same caller.

**Smallest contract.** Committed brief repo/inputSha/path; target repo/baseSha; pinned `.factory/models.json` SHA+sha256; selected researcher tuple (GLM/high → Luna/medium only from that pin); external trusted grant (absolute, outside project/runtime/store) naming role, exact approved ordered route, and numeric `totalAttempts`, `retryBudget`, `deadlineMs`, `outputBytes`; append-only call claim synced before the provider call. Call: `ModelRuntime.streamSimple(model, {messages}, {fetch: observer, maxRetries: 0, timeoutMs})`; no tools, session, or effects; await full stream end before any next destination; `totalAttempts` cumulative across tuples. Missing grant or any numeric budget refuses before fetch.

**Trigger.** 429 and unclassifiable errors = unknown → block. Prose, timeout, test, quality never route. 503 at the call-scoped fetch confirms request-level temporary unavailability (fetch sees status before the SDK's non-2xx error path), but spec-v1 requires bounded retries first; advance one tuple only when the granted retry budget is exhausted, the grant approves the transition, and the prior stream fully ended. 503 alone is not enough for immediate advance; quota advancement needs trusted separate authoritative evidence.

**Quota classifier blocked.** OpenAI `APIError.code` exists (`openai/core/error.d.ts`), but Pi collapses structured errors into `errorMessage` (`normalizeProviderError`); no supported consumer hook exposes it. Pi's `insufficient_quota` is a prose regex (`utils/retry.js:15`); OpenCode Go limits arrive as 429 JSON types. Fetch body-sniffing `error.code` is not grounded; use fixture-injected authoritative evidence, labeled policy proof.

**Zero retries, enforced.** OpenAI client default 2 (`openai/client.js:242`); adapter hard-sets per-request `maxRetries: 0` (`openai-completions.js:195`); Pi wrapper defaults 0 (`provider-retry.js:77`) but honors caller `maxRetries` (`:198`). Pass explicit 0; never AgentSession retry. Test one fetch per attempt on 429/503; a claimed-unfinished call blocks, no replay. No runtime grant exists now; offline fixtures only.
